topic: Car accident? How CTP claims work at our clinic

slides.headline: Car accident? Here's how CTP works
slides.sub: What to bring, who to contact and what happens at your first visit.

slides.title: Step 1: get checked medically
slides.body: After any crash, see your GP, or go to the emergency department if you're worried. Severe neck pain, numbness, weakness, confusion or a bad headache need prompt medical attention before anything else.

slides.title: Step 2: lodge your CTP claim
slides.body: CTP claims go through a compulsory third party insurer, and each state has its own process and time limits. Your GP, the insurer or your state's CTP regulator can explain the steps for you.

slides.title: Step 3: bring your claim number
slides.body: When you book, let us know it's a CTP claim. Bring your claim number, insurer details and any GP referral or certificate. It saves time and keeps the paperwork moving.

slides.title: What we handle for you
slides.body: Once your claim is accepted, we liaise with your insurer or case manager, send the reports they request and keep your treatment documented. The insurer decides what is approved, not us.

slides.title: What recovery usually looks like
slides.body: Most people recover well from common crash injuries like whiplash. Treatment usually focuses on staying gently active, restoring movement and gradually building back to work, driving and exercise.

slides.headline: Questions about your CTP claim?
slides.body: Call or book online and mention it's a CTP claim. Our team can talk you through what to bring and what happens at your first visit.

caption:
Been in a car accident and not sure how CTP works? Here's the short version.

First, get checked by your GP, or go to the emergency department if you have severe neck pain, numbness, weakness, confusion or a bad headache. Then lodge your claim with the CTP insurer. Each state has its own process and time limits, so your GP, the insurer or your state's CTP regulator can guide you.

When you book with us, mention it's a CTP claim and bring your claim number, insurer details and any GP paperwork. Once the claim is accepted, we liaise with your insurer or case manager and send the reports they need. Approval decisions sit with the insurer.

Most people recover well from common crash injuries with gentle activity and a gradual plan. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.

story.headline: Car accident? CTP in three steps
story.body: See your GP, lodge your claim, then bring your claim number to your first visit. We liaise with your insurer from there.
